question: Zakir Hussain is renowned for playing the ________.
solution:
The Correct answer is__** Tabla.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Zakir Hussain Alla Rakha Qureshi** was born on March 9, 1951, in Bombay, India.
 
• He is the son of Ustad Allah Rakha Khan, a well-known** Indian tabla player. **
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shree** by the Government of India in the year **1988**, thus making him the youngest percussionist ever to receive this award. 
 
• He was also awarded by the Govt of India's** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1990**
 
• In **2002,** Zakir Hussain once again became the youngest percussionist to be honored with India’s third-highest civilian award i.e** Padma Bhusan**
 
• He was also awarded the **Grammy in the year 1992 **for the album **‘Planet Drum**’ which was produced and created by** Zakir Hussain and Mickey Hart**.
 
• In **2006**, the government of **Madhya Pradesh** honored him with this prestigious **Kalidas Samman**, which is given to artists with exceptional achievements in their respective fields.​
 
• Recently in** 2023** he was awarded ** Padma Vibhushan **the second-highest civilian award by the Government of India.
 
• In** ****Feb 2024 , Ustad Zakir Hussain **along Rakesh Chaurasia, Shankar Mahadevan, Selvaganesh V, and Ganesh Rajagopalan won the Grammy award for the ‘Best Global Music’.
